info.name: Intelligent Medical Assistant API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Intelligent Medical Assistant backend.

## Base URL
`{{base_url}}` — default: `https://backend.hakim-app.cloud`

## Authentication
Every request needs **two** security headers:
1. `X-API-KEY` — static gateway key (set in collection variable `api_key`)
2. `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` — JWT from POST /auth/login

**Quick start:**
1. Set `api_key` in collection variables
2. Run **Login** — tokens are saved automatically
3. All other requests are ready to fire

## Enum Reference (use UPPERCASE exactly as shown)
- **Gender:** `MALE` | `FEMALE`
- **UserRole:** `DOCTOR` | `ASSISTANT` | `ADMIN`
- **AppointmentStatus:** `SCHEDULED` | `CONFIRMED` | `IN_PROGRESS` | `COMPLETED` | `CANCELLED` | `NO_SHOW`
- **VisitStatus:** `WAITING` | `IN_PROGRESS` | `COMPLETED` | `CANCELLED`
- **ReportStatus:** `DRAFT` | `CONFIRMED` | `REVIEWED` | `CANCELLED` | `APPROVED` | `FINALIZED`
- **ImageType:** `XRAY` | `SKIN`
- **ConditionCategory:** `CHRONIC` | `ALLERGY`
- **AuditAction:** `USER_CREATED` | `USER_UPDATED` | `USER_DELETED` | `LOGIN` | `TOKEN_REFRESH` | `LOGOUT` | `ACTIVATE` | `DEACTIVATE` | `PASSWORD_CHANGED` | `PATIENT_CREATED` | `PATIENT_DELETED` | `PATIENT_UPDATED` | `REPORT_CREATED` | `REPORT_UPDATED` | `REPORT_APPROVED` | `REPORT_FINALIZED` | `IMAGE_UPLOADED` | `LAB_UPLOADED` | `APPOINTMENT_CREATED` | `APPOINTMENT_UPDATED` | `APPOINTMENT_CANCELLED` | `APPOINTMENT_COMPLETED` | `VISIT_STARTED` | `VISIT_UPDATED` | `VISIT_COMPLETED`
